objet: Preuve scellee du containment 110/110 de tecdoc_map.source_linkages, mesuree le 2026-09-11.
portee: source_linkages uniquement. Ne prouve rien sur les autres couches TecDoc.
environnement: Base MassDoc PROD lue en SELECT seuls, transactions READ ONLY. Aucune ecriture, aucune reconstruction.

constat_non_normatif.note: Projection lisible du registre scelle ci-dessous. Le registre fait foi.

decisions_owner.note: Decisions prises par l'owner sur les quantites exactes ci-dessous. Elles ne constituent pas une autorisation de DROP.
decisions_owner.premisse_C1: acceptee sur reference au rejeu RAW scelle, sans remesure
decisions_owner.drop_reel: HOLD — plan de suppression exact exige avant toute autorisation

verification_du_sceau: python3 -c "import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); from tecdoc_seal import verifier; verifier(json.load(open('audit/massdoc-tecdoc-containment-proof-2026-09-11.json'))['registre_scelle'])"

registre_scelle.objet: Containment exhaustif de tecdoc_map.source_linkages : chaque ligne classee selon l'endroit ou son information subsiste.
registre_scelle.portee: 110/110 DLNR du perimetre RAW scelle. Aucune reconstruction de source_linkages, aucune ecriture PROD.
registre_scelle.invariant: Pour chaque DLNR : total_jointure == total_brut (I1) et C1 + HORS_TYPE_VEHICULE + C2 + C3 + C4 + sans_piece_id == total_brut (I2).

classes.C1_ARCHIVE: cle complete (article, gamme, type de cible, numero de cible) presente dans tecdoc_raw.t400 de PROD
classes.HORS_TYPE_VEHICULE: absente de l'archive, type de cible <> 2 : aucun equivalent dans le modele MassDoc
classes.C2_SERVI: type 2, absente de l'archive, presente dans public.pieces_relation_type sur le KTYP effectif
classes.C3_NON_SERVING_HISTORICAL: type 2, ni C1 ni C2, KTYP effectif absent de public.auto_type
classes.C4_FAMILLE: type 2, ni C1 ni C2, KTYP effectif vivant dans public.auto_type — caracterisee dans massdoc-tecdoc-c4-characterisation-2026-09-11.json
classes.sans_piece_id: type 2, absente de l'archive, ARTNR absent de tecdoc_map.article_registry

registre_scelle.ktyp_effectif: coalesce(tecdoc_map.type_id_remap.new_id, source_vknzielnr) : les 23 457 old_id ont tous disparu de public.auto_type

C1_implique_archive.enonce: PROD ⊆ SOURCE : toute ligne du t400 de PROD existe dans l'archive TecDoc. Etabli par le rejeu RAW scelle 110/110 (en_trop_dans_prod = 0 sur chaque DLNR), NON remesure ici.

premisses.transformation_ktyp: La resolution KTYP -> type_id est celle du pipeline (identite via linkage_target_registry puis type_id_remap). Sa validite semantique pour les KTYP non remappes n'est pas evaluee ici.

methode.lecture_seule: chaque requete dans BEGIN READ ONLY (refus serveur SQLSTATE 25006 eprouve avant la premiere mesure)
methode.instrument_sql:
with sl as (
  select sl.source_artnr::text as artnr, sl.pg_id_source as pgid,
         sl.source_vknzielart::int as vkart, sl.source_vknzielnr as ktyp
    from tecdoc_map.source_linkages sl where sl.source_dlnr = %(d)s
),
src as (
  select distinct t.col_1 as artnr, coalesce(nullif(t.col_4,'')::int, 0) as pgid,
         nullif(t.col_5,'')::int as vkart, t.col_6::int as ktyp
    from tecdoc_raw.t400 t where t.col_2 = %(ds)s
),
lie as (
  select sl.artnr, sl.pgid, sl.vkart, sl.ktyp, (src.artnr is not null) as en_archive
    from sl left join src
      on src.artnr = sl.artnr and src.pgid = sl.pgid and src.vkart = sl.vkart and src.ktyp = sl.ktyp
),
residu as (select artnr, pgid, vkart, ktyp from lie where not en_archive),
eff as (
  select r.*, ar.piece_id,
         case when r.vkart = 2 then coalesce(rm.new_id, r.ktyp) end as ktyp_eff,
         (r.vkart = 2 and rm.new_id is not null) as remappe
    from residu r
    left join tecdoc_map.article_registry ar
           on ar.source_artnr::text = r.artnr and ar.source_dlnr = %(d)s
    left join tecdoc_map.type_id_remap rm on r.vkart = 2 and rm.old_id = r.ktyp
),
classe as (
  select e.*,
    coalesce(e.vkart = 2 and e.piece_id is not null and exists (
        select 1 from public.pieces_relation_type prt
         where prt.rtp_piece_id = e.piece_id and prt.rtp_type_id = e.ktyp_eff), false) as servi,
    coalesce(e.vkart = 2 and exists (
        select 1 from public.auto_type t where t.type_id_i = e.ktyp_eff), false) as ktyp_existe
  from eff e
)
select
  (select count(*) from sl)                          as total_brut,
  (select count(*) from lie)                         as total_jointure,
  (select count(*) from lie where en_archive)        as c1_archive,
  count(*) filter (where vkart is distinct from 2)                                           as hors_type_vehicule,
  count(*) filter (where vkart = 2 and servi)                                                as c2_servi,
  count(*) filter (where vkart = 2 and not servi and piece_id is null)                       as sans_piece_id,
  count(*) filter (where vkart = 2 and not servi and piece_id is not null and not ktyp_existe) as c3,
  count(*) filter (where vkart = 2 and not servi and piece_id is not null and ktyp_existe)     as c4,
  count(*) filter (where remappe)                                                            as ktyp_remappe,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(vkart, n), '{}'::jsonb)
     from (select vkart, count(*) n from residu where vkart is distinct from 2 group by 1) z) as hors_par_type
from classe
methode.versions_ecartees: Deux executions anterieures ont ete jetees, non recyclees : l'une n'appliquait pas type_id_remap avant C3, l'autre ignorait le type de cible (source_vknzielart).
